messages.嫉妬共鳴を高めて自分と味方に充電と嫉妬ダメージ量増加を配る、サポート特化の嫉妬貫: A support-focused Envy Pierce E.G.O that raises Envy Resonance to hand out Charge and Envy DMG Up to himself and allies.
messages.充電の配布: 攻撃前に自分の充電が8(解析Ⅳで12)増え、攻撃後に充電が最も低い: **Distributing Charge**: Before attacking, his Charge increases by 8 (12 at Threadspin Ⅳ), and after attacking, the ally with the lowest Charge also gains 8.
messages.嫉妬共鳴で対象が増える: 最大嫉妬共鳴数が高いほど配る対象が増える(最大3、解析: **More targets with Envy Resonance**: The higher the highest Envy Resonance, the more allies receive it (up to 3, 4 at Threadspin Ⅲ, 5 at Ⅳ).
messages.嫉妬ダメージ量増加: 解析Ⅲから、最大嫉妬共鳴数が4以上(Ⅳは6以上)なら、自分: **Envy DMG Up**: From Threadspin Ⅲ, if the highest Envy Resonance is 4 or more (6 or more at Ⅳ), gives 1 Envy DMG Up to himself and the targets. The effect lasts only that turn.
messages.パッシブ「過負荷ケーブル」: 戦闘開始時に共鳴が4以上発動していれば攻撃レベル増: **Passive — Overloading Cables**: Gains 2 Offense Level Up and 2 Defense Level Up if a Resonance of 4 or more is active at Combat Start. With Envy Resonance, the allies on both sides of him on the dashboard also receive them.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 嫉妬共鳴数に応じて広域化し、充電を消耗してダメージ量を増やす。: **Corrosion skill**: Becomes multi-target based on Envy Resonance and spends Charge to increase damage.
messages.嫉妬スキルを並べて共鳴を作ってから撃つ。共鳴が低いと配る対象が少ない。: Line up Envy skills to build Resonance before using it. With low Resonance, few allies receive the distribution.
messages.充電人格や嫉妬スキルが多い編成で撃つ。充電人格とそれ以外の混成だと、充電人格以外: Use it in teams with many Charge Identities or Envy skills. In teams that mix Charge Identities with others, non-Charge Identities may end up as targets.
messages.必要資源は憤怒1・嫉妬4で、嫉妬の多い編成なら賄える。: It requires 1 Wrath and 4 Envy, which an Envy-heavy team can cover.
messages.Ⅱ: 「過負荷ケーブル」が解放される。この編成で使うなら最低限ここまで。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Overloading Cables. If you use it in this kind of team, take it at least this far.
messages.Ⅲ: 配る対象が最大4に増え、嫉妬ダメージ量増加が付く。侵蝕の広域も強化される。: **Ⅲ**: Raises the number of targets to up to 4 and adds Envy DMG Up. Corrosion's multi-target range also improves.
messages.Ⅳ: 自分の充電が12、対象が最大5に増える。嫉妬ダメージ量増加の条件が共鳴6以: **Ⅳ**: His own Charge becomes 12, and targets rise to up to 5. The Envy DMG Up condition changes to 6 or more Resonance.
messages.中指末弟: 嫉妬のS2・守備や嫉妬共鳴を条件とするスキルを持ち、嫉妬共鳴を作りや: **[The Middle Little Brother](persona:0507)**: Has an Envy S2 and Defense skill plus skills conditioned on Envy Resonance, makes Envy Resonance easy to build, and also restores SP.
messages.R社第4群サイチーム: 嫉妬(S1・守備)で資源と共鳴に参加でき、S1・S2が充: **[R Corp. 4th Pack Rhino](persona:0506)**: Envy (S1, Defense skill) lets him join in resources and Resonance, and S1 and S2 increase Charge, so he can be both distributor and recipient.
